title: Business Analyst Fresher
description: Job Description – Business Analyst (Fresher) Company: Tridots Tech Pvt. Ltd. Experience: Freshers (0–1 Year) Employment Type: Full-Time Location: Porur, Chennai Work Mode: On-site About the Role We are looking for enthusiastic and detail-oriented fresh graduates to join our team as Business Analysts. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, strong analytical thinking, and an interest in understanding business processes and technology solutions. The role involves interacting with clients, understanding their business requirements, documenting workflows, and coordinating with technical teams to deliver effective software solutions. Candidates will receive guidance and opportunities to develop their skills in ERP solutions and business analysis. Key Responsibilities Interact with clients and stakeholders to understand their business requirements and business processes. Assist in requirement gathering, analysis, and documentation. Understand business workflows and identify opportunities for process improvement. Prepare business requirement documents, functional specifications, process flows, and reports. Coordinate with developers, consultants, and other internal teams to communicate client requirements. Assist in ERP implementation, configuration, testing, and support activities. Participate in client meetings, product demonstrations, and requirement discussions. Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and validate solutions against business requirements. Maintain project documentation and provide regular updates on assigned tasks. Continuously learn about ERP systems, business operations, and emerging technologies. Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong analytical, logical reasoning, and problem-solving abilities. Confidence in interacting with clients and understanding their requirements. Good documentation, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Basic knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint. Interest in software applications, business processes, and ERP solutions. Ability to learn quickly and work collaboratively in a team environment. A proactive attitude with attention to detail and willingness to take responsibility. Preferred Skills (Added Advantage) Basic understanding of ERP systems such as ERPNext, Odoo, or similar platforms. Familiarity with business processes such as Sales, Purchase, Inventory, HR, or Accounting. Basic understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC). Knowledge of Agile methodologies or project management tools. What We Offer Opportunity to work on real-time ERP implementation projects. Practical exposure to client interactions and business process analysis. Professional guidance and on-the-job learning. Opportunity to develop functional and technical knowledge in ERP solutions. Career growth opportunities in Business Analysis and ERP Consulting. Interested candidates can share their updated resumes with us. title: Senior Analyst - Data Science
description: Designation : Senior Analyst - Data Science. Level : L2 Location : Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. Experience : 3 to 6 years Job Role : Education: PhD in Statistics, Data Science, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, or a related quantitative field. Research & Publication Mindset: Strong record or potential for publishing original research in top-tier machine learning conference proceedings or journals. Technical Expertise: Advanced domain knowledge in Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), Transformers, Variational Autoencoders (VAEs), and cutting-edge deep learning architectures. Programming & Tools: Expert-level mastery of Python, PyTorch/PyTorch Geometric (PyG), DGL, SQL, and core statistical modeling libraries. Cutting-Edge R&D: Design, develop, and benchmark state-of-the-art ML and Graph Neural Network (GNN) algorithms to uncover complex fraud networks and anti-money laundering (AML) patterns. End-to-End Delivery: Lead the complete lifecycle of advanced machine learning models—from problem formulation, data extraction, and feature engineering to production deployment and monitoring. Responsibilities : 3+ years of experience in applied analytics, ML, or data science. Applied Innovation & Publications: Translate novel AI/ML research into production-grade enterprise solutions while identifying key breakthroughs for academic publication and IP creation. Scalable Data Architecture: Build, optimize, and maintain large-scale data and ML pipelines utilizing Python, SQL, and AWS infrastructure (SageMaker, Redshift, Lambda, S3). Platform Integration: Support the integration, real-time scoring, and evaluation of ML models into enterprise fraud detection platforms such as Feedzai. Performance & Compliance: Continuously monitor model drift and performance metrics, ensuring all deployed solutions comply strictly with financial regulatory and governance standards.
